features.name: log_broadband_signal_energy
features.description: Log-compressed mean intensity across representative anchors from violet through far NIR; captures overall specimen brightness while reducing extreme leverage.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth scale coordinate so a linear SVM can adjust margins for global radiance differences without relying on many correlated raw bands.

features.name: centered_visible_shape_projection
features.description: Training-normalized weighted projection of key visible and tail anchors, using unsupervised per-band means and standard deviations from the training fold.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies an approximate one-dimensional color-shape coordinate that is already centered and well scaled for a linear margin.

features.name: early_rise_450_520_index
features.description: Normalized rise from blue reflectance to early green reflectance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps linear margins capture the steepness of the low-wavelength ascent as a single smooth contrast.

features.name: green_blue_contrast_index
features.description: Normalized contrast between the main green-yellow hump and the violet/blue baseline.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses a broad hump-vs-baseline pattern into one ratio, reducing reliance on many collinear raw bands.

features.name: green_plateau_tilt_index
features.description: Signed tilt from the 530-545 nm side of the green plateau to the 561-581 nm side.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a directional peak-shape coordinate that can shift a linear margin without needing separate weights for each plateau band.

features.name: orange_red_drop_index
features.description: Normalized drop from orange wavelengths into the red and early far-red region.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes a broad descending segment as a stable signed contrast, useful for linear separation of spectral shapes.

features.name: red_tail_collapse_index
features.description: Normalized contrast between red-region intensity and the much lower 731-783 nm tail.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the severity of the post-red intensity collapse in one smooth coordinate for margin-based modeling.

features.name: far_nir_residual_fraction
features.description: Fraction of far-NIR residual signal relative to the green-yellow hump.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers a bounded tail-strength measure that can separate true broad signal from near-zero long-wavelength background.

features.name: narrowband_815_spike_index
features.description: Signed narrowband excess at 814.5 nm relative to neighboring bands at 810.5 nm and 818.4 nm.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures a localized spectral anomaly as a single bounded variable, preventing a linear SVM from overusing adjacent raw bands independently.

features.name: longwave_960_peak_index
features.description: Signed peak strength around 955-969 nm relative to shoulders near 936-948 nm and 991-997 nm.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a compact longwave shape contrast that is robust to multiplicative brightness changes.

features.name: smooth_single_hump_confidence
features.description: Numeric assessor score from 0.0 to 1.0; high values indicate a coherent single visible hump with smooth flanks and low high-frequency ripple, while low values indicate irregular or multimodal spectral morphology. Assess only from the row spectrum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact morphology cue that can combine linearly with ratio features when raw bands are noisy.

features.name: acquisition_artifact_severity
features.description: Numeric assessor rating from 0.0 to 10.0 of acquisition artifacts, considering repeated zero-like tail readings, isolated tall spikes, or implausible discontinuities relative to neighboring bands. Assess only from the row spectrum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows a linear margin to account for sensor-quality variation without assigning many separate weights to narrow artifacts.
